provenance.command_note: Interpreter path normalized to python; runtime version is recorded separately.

statistics.p95_method: nearest rank over measured batch repetitions; with five samples P95 equals the maximum
statistics.spread: min, max and sample standard deviation of measured repetitions; not a confidence interval
statistics.warmups: recorded separately and excluded from all timing summaries
statistics.speedup: median serial batch wall time divided by median concurrent batch wall time

overhead.description: Incremental harness work above a direct runner + exact-scoring loop; no simulated wait.

integrity.interpretation: Deterministic functional checks; these pass rates do not estimate model accuracy or CI reliability.

limitations: No model, agent CLI, network service or LLM judge is called; no API credentials are used.
Sleep-based concurrency measures controlled waiting, not real provider throughput or rate limits.
Arithmetic is solved by deterministic code; 100% here is fixture correctness, not agent intelligence.
Timing depends on this machine and its current load; small sample P95 is descriptive, not a stable tail estimate.
Incremental overhead includes result construction, validation, per-case timing and aggregation, compared with a minimal runner/scorer loop.
No cross-framework comparisons, model rankings, token counts or monetary costs are measured.
